theory.name: Langarian Finite Complex Transformations
theory.summary: The executable finite-complex-vector package currently powering the workbench.
theory.motivation: Make mathematical transformations reproducible, receipt-bearing, and unable to overstate what one computation establishes.

objects.name: ResonantState
objects.definition: A finite vector in C^n, 1 <= n <= 64, plus bounded metadata and receipt history.

objects.name: OperationReceipt
objects.definition: A versioned integrity record for one operator execution and its checks.

objects.name: BridgeResult
objects.definition: A recorded source/target relation candidate with similarity and edge-local declared cost.

preconditions: Input is a valid finite complex state.
angle is a finite real number in radians.

predicates.statement: The output is a finite state with the same dimension as the input.
Output norm equals input norm within the declared numerical policy.
The receipt records input hash, output hash, operator, parameters, and versions.

failure_conditions.condition: Input fails state validation or dimension limits.
A required predicate fails after execution.

contract.first_falsifier: An admissible finite input and angle for which independent high-precision evaluation disagrees with exp(i theta)x beyond the numerical policy.

operators.name: harmonic_sum
operators.semantics: Zero-pad to a common dimension and add componentwise.

preconditions: Both inputs are valid finite complex states.

predicates.statement: The output is a valid finite complex state.
Each output component equals the sum of the explicitly padded input components.
The receipt records both input hashes and the output hash.

reversibility.condition: The output alone does not uniquely recover both input vectors.

contract.first_falsifier: A valid input pair for which the implementation output differs from explicit zero-padding followed by componentwise addition.

operators.name: attenuated_phase_shift
operators.semantics: A_(theta,eta)(x) = eta exp(i theta) x for eta >= 0.

parameters.name: Declared cost label
parameters.constraints: Required by the current I3 gate when eta < 1.

preconditions: Input is a valid finite complex state.

predicates.statement: The output is a valid finite state with unchanged dimension.
Output norm equals eta times input norm within the numerical policy.
When eta < 1, a non-empty declared cost label is present.
The receipt records input hash, output hash, theta, eta, cost declaration, and versions.

failure_conditions.condition: angle or attenuation is non-finite, or attenuation is negative.
eta < 1 and no declared cost label is supplied.
eta > 1 under the current decrease-only accounting rule.

reversibility.condition: Reversible exactly when eta > 0, using angle -theta and scale 1/eta; eta = 0 is irreversible.

contract.first_falsifier: An admissible input, angle, and eta for which the output differs from eta exp(i theta)x or the receipt misstates the declared cost boundary.

operators.name: bridge
operators.semantics: Record a source/target relation candidate, normalized similarity, and an edge-local caller declaration.

parameters.name: Declared edge cost
parameters.constraints: Edge-local caller declaration only; not accumulated path cost.

preconditions: Source and target are valid finite complex states.

predicates.statement: Both source and target states pass validation.
Recorded normalized similarity lies in [0,1] under the software zero-vector convention.
The receipt labels cost as edge-local and does not infer accumulated path cost.
The receipt records both endpoint hashes, similarity, declared edge cost, and versions.

failure_conditions.condition: Declared edge cost is NaN or infinite.
The result is presented as equality, path equivalence, provenance completeness, or zero path cost.

reversibility.condition: The current operation records a relation candidate and does not transform source into target.

contract.first_falsifier: A valid run whose receipt erases intermediate history, treats edge cost as path cost, or records similarity outside the declared bounded convention.

assumptions.text: The executable model is finite-dimensional and represented with finite IEEE-754 components.
Zero-padding is the selected embedding convention for unequal dimensions.

invariants.text: phase_shift preserves Euclidean norm in exact arithmetic.
Every operation receipt records declared input hashes and an output hash or relation target hash.
A bridge edge declaration must not be promoted into a claim about accumulated path cost or state equality.

allowed: listed contract predicates ran under declared versions
two implementation surfaces conform to reviewed fixtures
prohibited: a demonstration fixture is mathematically privileged
zero bridge edge cost means zero historical path cost
implementation agreement is independent scientific confirmation

evidence.notes: The package is a mathematical software workbench, not an empirically validated physical theory.
